title: Shaam hai gharibon
body:
shaam hai ghareebon ki dard naak manzar hai
be-hawaas maidan mein itrat e payambar hai
dard naak manzar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
teeragi hai dehshat hai haye kya qayamat hai
hai haram ki nigraani aur ali ki dukhtar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaa chuki hai tareeki phir bhi zulm hai jaari
shimr ke tamache hai shaah e deen ki dukhtar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek yateem bacchi ko haye yun mila pursa
kaan hogaye zakhmi pusht khoon mein tar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kya bhara ghar tha aur ab hai sannata
subha ka tha wo manzar shaam ka ye manzar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal chuke hai sab qaime bibiyan hui be-aas
ab na koi waaris hai aur na sar pe chadar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya likhe bhala koi haal e abid e muztar
aasman saaya hai aur zameen bistar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ke gulshan ko kis tarha kiya taara
ab na koi akbar hai aur na koi asghar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar hai sajde mein sajid behre shukr bete ka
saamne hi naize par baap ka kata sar hai
dard naak manzar hai
shaam hai ghareebon ki...
author: Sajid Razvi
